notes: Phoenix fire (docs/homm3_vfx_experiments.md 'Phoenix fire'; lab tools/homm3_vfx/phoenix_fire_lab.py). DEF motion: the body texture boils in place (31-42% of body px change per frame, velocity 0), flames are redrawn every frame at 12 fps with no travel, the hot core is mostly steady. Body: a `fire` defPalette region (texture: Lab chroma rule; DEF: body luma >= 100) whose colours are the DEF's own fire palette ranked by the fire_boil scores (luminance + steady chest core + boil noise); the dark rest (beak, talons, feather strokes) keeps the v7c grade. Self-lit read: body_fire is a floor light (Hex/Lit has no emission; the lab showed a baked glow cannot do it). Loops add procedural fire_tongues (lab C6; prefab not built). Attack / hit / death are DEF-ripped flipbooks from region-segmented file masks (tools/homm3_vfx/phoenix_fire_masks.py; the roster colour rule cannot see fire on a fire body).

lighting.notes: No bakedGlow: the lab's baked lift bought almost nothing under Hex/Lit (L-hist 11.6 -> 11.0, hot core 0); the hot core now comes from the DEF palette's white-hot end placed on the chest by the scores' steady core term, and the self-lit brightness from the body_fire floor.

lights.notes: always-on body fire: per-clip floor (the grade is fitted under it) + authored hit flash and death flare; goes out on death frame 3
attack: the jet lights the head and chest; fitted rise

layers.provenance: phoenix_fire_scores.py: 8 cells of rank(luminance + 0.6 chest core + beta * boil noise), beta 0.90 bisected so the simulated per-cell change of the fire texels under the DEF palette is the DEF idle body change 0.347; a new cell per new DEF frame, repeated DEF frames reuse the cell (mouseover/defence are DEF 5-frame ping-pongs, move_end is move_start reversed)

volfire.py: CPHX.DEF idle (g2, 8 frames) cut into fixed windows, each an 8-frame flipbook of the DEF's own flicker at that spot (crest tongues + body boil) + detached DEF ember specks; replaces the unbuilt fire_tongues prefab (lab C6)
layers.notes: Emitted from the whole skinned body minus the legs (by joint name, not the old mesh's UVs, so it carries to the firebird-based rebuild) as camera-facing unlit billboards (view-independent volume): tongues from the upper 65% (normal up >= 0), body boil from the upper 75%, embers from the upper half. Death: burns on keys 0-2, fades on 3, no births from 4, cleared at 5 with hide_body (death_burn / death_ash flipbooks take over).

Floors from the lab's per-frame absolute fit (idle 0.67-0.98 -> 0.8, move 0.23-0.35 -> 0.3, hit tail 0.44-0.47 -> 0.45); the hit flash (DEF core 20% on frames 0-1) and death flare (white-hot 0-1, burning 2, dark 3+) are authored on the lab's curves because the runner's fitted rise is measured over the clip's first key, which is where both flashes are. Death has no floor: the fire goes out.

layers.provenance: phoenix_fire_masks.py (phoenix_fire_lab.breath_mask): frame 3 flame+ember in front of 62% of the body width; frames 4-11 everything opaque in front of the beak (DEF x >= 276, y >= 190 until x >= 320); frames 4-9 alternate 4/5 three times (the DEF's 2-frame 6 Hz flicker), 10 = the jet detached, 11 = remnants
layers.notes: defOrigin is the DEF jet root (x 276, mean y 214), pinned to the Head bone tail: the mesh does not lunge (its beak stays near DEF (237-250, 150-155) while the sprite's head drops to y ~214), so the jet leaves the mesh beak rather than the sprite's beak position. The detached jet (10-11) keeps its DEF offset from that root.
Rise over body_fire's attack floor; the runner rewrites the curve. Carried from frame 0 (liveness) though the breath draws from 3.

layers.provenance: phoenix_fire_masks.py: DEF g3 detached embers (229 -> 835 px, flung outward); origin = the DEF body centroid of each frame

phoenix_fire_masks.py: DEF g5 frames 0-3 crest tips + flame + embers (white-hot flare, wings burning), frame 4 the whole frame off the mesh (the pillar of fire, 53% above the body); origin = the DEF body centroid of each frame

phoenix_fire_masks.py: DEF g5 frames 5-6, the whole frame (the ash pile); origin = the SpriteCam's projection of the world origin (spritecam offset 224.25, 267.65), so the pile sits where the DEF draws it
layers.notes: Billboard, not groundPlane: the pile is a side-view mound (height 30-40 px), not a flat pool; laid on the ground it would foreshorten to a smear.
All unit SkinnedMeshRenderers (body + h3_phoenix_Rubble): the ash flipbook replaces the unit.

vfx.notes: Rebirth is not in CPHX.DEF (no group; c09spf0 is a summon portal). Not covered here.
